### Risks

- A final audit performed before the last evidence would be stale.
- A broad diff could absorb unrelated user changes.
- Source-only test results could be overstated as installed or end-to-end behavior.

### Acceptance criteria

- Every TRD requirement and acceptance criterion has current direct implementation and verification evidence, and every changed artifact maps back to a requirement or approved design basis.
- The impact matrix confirms the required Task and Director sources changed and every Agent Task or role-management file has a justified changed or unchanged disposition.
- Post-change hashes and scoped status affirmatively show every protected active path unchanged, the deleted reusable sys4ai-depot role remains deleted, unmanaged plan files remain byte-identical, and no new generated residue remains.
- The final report identifies exact checks, observed results, highest verification level, source-only validation, and all unexercised adoption, publication, deployment, and live native orchestration behavior.
- The project Task is completed only through the separate Task workflow after its exact definition of done has current direct evidence.

### Planned verification

- Reopen the canonical plan and TRD after the last implementation evidence and verify IDs, scope, open decisions, and source digest.
- Run a forward audit from each source and REQ-001 through REQ-023 to tasks, files, tests, and evidence.
- Run a reverse audit from every changed file and test to requirements or approved design basis.
- Recompute all protected hashes and scoped Git status strictly after the last test and compare with TASK-001.
- Run final focused tests, validators, diff checks, and generated-residue inspection, then record observed results without upgrading unexercised behavior.
